name: Evaluated Project Skill Package
mechanism: Packages one repeated project workflow as a progressively disclosed SKILL.md with explicit triggers inputs outputs stop conditions and optional deterministic scripts or references, admits it as a pinned dependency, then promotes it only after paired fresh-context evaluation.
use_when: A project workflow is repeated and requires non-obvious repository knowledge
Baseline tasks show a specific procedure improves agent reliability
avoid_when: The model already performs the workflow reliably without the skill
The content is an always-applicable project fact or a mechanical invariant better placed in instructions or CI
The skill source scripts assets or required authority cannot be reviewed and pinned
expected_effects: Reusable task procedure without permanently consuming full startup context
Measurable improvement on the targeted project workflow
failure_modes: Generic LLM-written guidance adds no value over the baseline
Description causes false activation or misses relevant requests
Vendor extensions make the skill non-portable or silently change authority
Large instructions crowd out task context and reduce adherence
Version-mismatched advice conflicts with the repository
Copied skill instructions or scripts create a supply-chain path to unauthorized effects
Relevant-looking guidance causes implementation omissions or excessive verification
required_evals: repository language dependency artifact-path permission and cost eligibility checks
fresh-context with-skill versus baseline or semantically matched task comparison
token latency and tool-call overhead comparison
unsupported input and unsafe-action stop tests
content digest authority and adversarial admission review
